roles: informal power broker within the department and local businesses
public-facing 'friendly neighborhood cop' with a hidden predatory side

appearance.build: stocky, muscular with a softening midsection; thick neck and broad chest
appearance.skin: warm tan with faint freckles; outdoors-worn
appearance.face: round face; heavy brows; smile that narrows eyes into lines; approachable at first glance
appearance.hair: short cropped, slightly receding hairline; often looks freshly trimmed
appearance.eyes: medium brown; watchful; the friendliness can switch off instantly
distinctive_marks: old burn scar on the back of one hand
typical_outfit: slightly rumpled police uniform worn with practiced confidence
always wears a leather wristwatch even though it no longer works
signature_props: scuffed pocket notebook with pencil erasures

core: morally numbed by years of small compromises
strengths: excellent at social leverage and favors
flaws: addictive reliance on power and routine
cowardly around higher status when consequences appear
wants: to keep the town's 'order' on his terms
to maintain his local legend even if it's built on rot
contradictions: can genuinely help vulnerable people, then exploit others the same day
seeks respect but earns fear and resentment
claims 'it's for the town' while protecting himself first

tics: uses paperwork as a minimizer of wrongdoing
catchphrases: This town needs a strong hand.

family.mother: retail worker; died during his early training years
family.children: one daughter living out of state with ex-wife

youth: high school football lineman; learned that strength equals authority

career_timeline.event: police academy; mother's death; first exposure to institutional politics
career_timeline.impact: idealism thinned; began equating obedience/upward loyalty with survival

career_timeline.event: new patrol officer; becomes popular 'local hero'
career_timeline.impact: habit of discretionary leniency becomes a gateway to favors

career_timeline.event: enters local business circles; starts 'fixing' problems quietly; promoted
career_timeline.impact: corruption normalizes as a 'system' and a 'service'
identity collapses into badge + local status; loneliness worsens

career_timeline.event: corruption becomes routine; department becomes dependent/afraid; enemies accumulate
career_timeline.impact: moral numbness; paranoia; increasingly coercive behavior

corruption_profile.pattern: small, frequent abuses that compound into systemic capture
typical_offenses: selective enforcement (warnings for allies, tickets for targets)
leveraging confidential info for leverage or money
paperwork manipulation (missing entries, 'lost' notes, altered logs)
using departmental resources as private protection for nightlife interests
corruption_profile.cover_story: keeping the town running; 'everyone does it'; 'it’s just paperwork'

departmental_dynamic.upward: has leverage on superiors; feeds them plausible deniability
departmental_dynamic.downward: trains subordinates into the 'Beef way'; punishes dissent socially and professionally

superior_officer.dynamic: superior benefits from deniability; Beef benefits from cover

young_subordinate.dynamic: loyalty mixed with fear and moral conflict

bar_owner_confidant.dynamic: knows too much; could save or doom him depending on pressure

outsider_investigator.dynamic: sees patterns others normalized; triggers escalation

story_hooks.inciting_incident: a vigilante 'citizen-arrest' streamer begins teasing an exposé (#BeefGate) and collecting proof
pressure_escalation: leaks of small incidents that look harmless alone but damning together
superiors begin distancing; allies go quiet
public sentiment fractures: 'local hero' vs 'dirty cop'
story_hooks.climax_setup: streamer orchestrates a planned public confrontation and 'citizen arrest' designed for maximum live spectacle
themes: identity collapse when the badge is stripped

symbols.coffee_cup: routine as false safety; the last peaceful mask
symbols.broken_watch: stopped time / broken promises; clinging to identity
